title: Random forest risk model for ovarian cancer within one year of screening
summary: AUC was 0.930 (0.886-0.974) in PLCO data (15-fold cross-validation on 150,907 events) and 0.910 externally, with sensitivity 91.9% and specificity 72.6%. Internal PPV was 2.9% and the external cohort is retrospective.
organization: University Hospitals Cleveland Medical Center; Case Western Reserve University, USA

evidence.tested: 15-fold CV on 150,907 events plus external retrospective cohort
evidence.unknown: PPV 2.9% internal; retrospective external cohort; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Random forest predicts ovarian cancer within one year of screening

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
